description:

The Macabre Hat of Teeth
A museum in South London contains a disturbing tattered hat made of brown felt and decorated with more than 80 human teeth; using the latest imaging technology, experts investigate to uncover the macabre origins of this mysterious Victorian-era cap.

title: Strangest Things
description:
The Psychograph
Investigating whether a machine can read personalities; an ancient golden mask painted with human blood; a cursed chicken pot.

title: BattleBots
description:
S03 E05 — Just Keep Spinning
A brutal match-up between Icewave and Yeti ignites the Battlebox, while the best bots in the world flex their gears.

title: BattleBots
description:
S03 E06 — It's a Flipppin' Robot Party!
World-class robots Bronco and Bombshell go head-to-head as the elite group of robots compete for the title of 2018 BattleBots World Champion.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E03 — A President's Close Encounter
The discovery of geysers on a moon; NASA's mission to detect life; an object is spotted approaching an asteroid.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E04 — How Black Holes Made Us
Black holes are not the violent monsters people think they are, and new discoveries reveal that they might have been essential to creating stars, giving light, and building the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E03 — The Interstellar Mysteries
Discoveries about interstellar space, the space between the universe's stars, reveal that it's not empty and unremarkable as previously thought, but filled with weird objects and strange phenomena that might hold the darkest secrets of the cosmos.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S07 E08 — Hunt for Alien Life
The latest discoveries suggest life beyond this planet; scientists investigate if earth's life began elsewhere in the universe, and whether humans need to evolve to know for sure.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E05 — Digital Doomsday
Weapons of mass destruction now include chemical, hypersonic and cyber threats. Like any weapon, cyberattacks can cripple nations, threatening society's survival.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E04 — The Unseen Fear
Despite bans, dangerous chemical weapons are still used by certain regimes. Explore how these weapons are used and how they can possibly contribute to the threat of future biological warfare.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E03 — Shock and Awe
Directed energy weapons, once only seen in science fiction, are now reality. They can disable cities' circuits and destroy missiles, heralding space warfare.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E01 — Future Soldier
Electronic warfare, drones and AI-driven soldiers define modern combat. Learn more about the digitized battlefield with enhanced soldiers, killer robots and lethal autonomous weapons.

title: Modern Warfare 2.0
description:
S01 E02 — Death From Above
Originally for reconnaissance, drones now carry missiles and bombs; the Reaper, a hunter-killer, exemplifies advanced tech and our path towards AI; exploring unmanned warfare.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S05 E01 — Texas Fertilizer Catastrophe
A deadly explosion strikes at the heart of a small Texas town and leaves a community in ruins; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover a nearby fertilizer plant containing volatile chemicals poised for disaster.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E02 — Miami's Condo Catastrophe
Catastrophe strikes Miami, Fla., as a 13-story condominium tower collapses with deadly debris; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover an uncontrolled method of demolition that led to catastrophic failure.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E10 — Bay Area Bridge of Mayhem
A devastating earthquake wreaks havoc on an iconic San Francisco bridge and leaves drivers fearing for their lives; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover a weakened expansion joint caused by catastrophic shockwaves.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E06 — Manhattan Crane Chaos
New York residents get a rude awakening when a disastrous crane collapse causes chaos on the downtown streets of Manhattan; experts use the latest tech to investigate and reveal how a slight increase in wind conditions created major catastrophe.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E04 — Memphis Bridge of Doom
A vital Mississippi River interstate crossing is discovered to be in danger of imminent collapse in Memphis; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover severely compromised load-bearing tension members with a life-threatening weakness.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E05 — Texas Oil Port Inferno
A deadly explosion strikes a major crude oil port creating an inferno of epic proportions in Corpus Christi, Texas; experts use the latest science to investigate and uncover a failed dredging operation that ruptured a propane pipeline.

title: Engineering Catastrophes
description:
S06 E03 — Jacksonville's Parking Garage Disaster

description:

Astronomers notice a planet in Earth's vicinity capable of supporting life; top secret military program exposed; the moon contains the components to start life.

description:

Cosmologists say there are black holes throughout the Universe, but they've never seen one, and it's almost impossible to study them directly.

title: How the Universe Works
description:

Our solar system is home to hundreds of strange, tiny worlds called dwarf planets, and new discoveries reveal the secrets of these mysterious places.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S02 E01 — Shipwreck of Nazi Treasure
Jeremy Wade explores a shipwreck that may contain stolen Nazi treasure, the priceless lost furnishings of the 18th century Amber Room; astonishing footage captures the exact moment when freight ship MV Arvin split in two and sank in the Black Sea.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S02 E04 — Secrets of the MS Estonia
Jeremy Wade follows investigators as they dive the wreck of the ferry MS Estonia; the case of America's notorious skyjacker D. B. Cooper takes an intriguing underwater twist.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S02 E07 — Secrets of Russia's Nuclear Sub
Jeremy Wade explores an accident involving a Russian nuclear submarine on a top-secret mission, and shocking details emerge surrounding the vessel's design; scientists investigate ancient human remains emerging from a lake in Finland.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S02 E08 — Mystery of the Sub Destroyer
Exploring the puzzling disappearance of an Indonesian submarine; the latest research into an underwater phenomenon may help piece together how it vanished.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S02 E06 — Titanic Phenomenon
Jeremy Wade investigates the infamous shipwreck of the Titanic; locals are baffled when a bag containing 54 severed human hands is found on the banks of a Siberian river.

title: Mysteries of the Deep
description:
S02 E05 — Debris Of Amelia Earhart
Jeremy Wade examines new evidence that could finally reveal what happened to aviator Amelia Earhart; Jeremy investigates a strange anchor found in the Mediterranean Sea.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S12 E01 — Soviet Slam Dunkers
An elaborate stadium in Lithuania hosts an unlikely Cold War matchup; an industrial relic in England gets caught in a heated labor dispute; a gothic-style tower in Memphis attracts rock and roll royalty.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S12 E08 — An Island Fit for a Mobster
Palatial ruins in Philadelphia symbolize an industrial golden age; a remote outpost in France is thrust to the front lines of World War II; a palazzo right off the Italian coast becomes a prison for mob bosses.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S12 E05 — Revolution in El Paso
An old compound in Texas bears the scars of a violent revolution; a secret facility outside Berlin is used by a dictator to escape justice; the estate of an aristocrat becomes a stronghold for the IRA.

description:

A Nazi concentration camp gets used for a grotesque publicity stunt, Oscar Wilde is imprisoned after a well-publicized trial, and a building in Memphis intended to protect becomes a symbol of corruption.

description: The latest archaeological research unravels the mystery behind this elusive Egyptian queen, whose name is synonymous with seduction, beauty and scandal.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E04 — Egypt's Lost Queen
A brand-new discovery inside a 3,000-year-old treasure chest may lead experts to the Egyptian pharaoh who was erased from history: a woman named Hatshepsut, who was one of the most controversial and successful pharaohs of all time.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E01 — The Screaming Mummy Conspiracy
The horrifying remains of the Screaming Mummy have haunted archaeologists for decades, but experts uncover new evidence to reveal the treacherous conspiracy that led to the mummy's grisly end.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E05 — Pharaoh of Niagara Falls
Leading scientists and Egyptologists use state-of-the-art forensics to investigate the Niagara Falls mummy and search for its true identity; how a legendary ancient Egyptian pharaoh ended up on the other side of the world.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E02 — Curse of the Warrior King
The mangled mummy of a pharaoh is a 3,000-year-old cold case that has brand-new leads; a team of experts in Egyptian archaeology and criminal forensics investigates fresh evidence to discover the truth behind the brutal death.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E06 — To Kill a King
The mysterious mummy of Ramesses V reveals a shocking tale of bitter family rivalry, civil insurrection and a cause of death that ultimately pushed Ancient Egypt to the edge of collapse.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E03 — Tut's Darkest Secret
Cutting-edge science reveals new discoveries about the mutilated mummy of a young woman with a secret link to Tutankhamun; as experts use modern-day criminal forensics to follow fresh leads, the bloody trail leads straight to the Boy King.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S05 E10 — Cannibal Death Pit
A strange circular forest next to a notorious cannibal site; when an eerie crater is spotted in Siberia, experts uncover if it could be evidence of Nikola Tesla's doomsday device; cutting-edge tech helps experts answer these sinister mysteries.

description:
S05 E05 — Ghost Fleet of Cannibal Bay
A fleet of sunken ships that point to ghosts, cannibals and bloodshed in early America; strange arctic holes that NASA can't explain; near Area 51, mysterious alien structures straight out of "Star Wars."

title: What on Earth?
description:

Alien monoliths haunt the coast of England; an obliterated jungle points to a brutal narco gold rush; evidence of a strange blood-red creature emerging from the deep.

A site that could be the Garden of Eden hides a deadly secret; when a gateway to hell suddenly opens, experts investigate where it leads; a mysterious shipwreck could be an infamous Soviet KGB pirate ship.
